summary: Let stringifySetCookie accept expires as epoch milliseconds as well as a Date, throwing on invalid numbers like an invalid Date does, with the type updated and tests added.
narrative: The owner asked for a small feature in the cookie project on 2026-11-03: stringifySetCookie should accept a numeric expires (milliseconds since the epoch) as well as a Date. An invalid number should throw the same way an invalid Date does, and the type and tests should be updated. Memory holds no observations for this conversation yet, so there is no recorded work, PR or release. The request is at its very start.

milestones.text: Owner asked for numeric epoch-millisecond expires support in stringifySetCookie, with type update and tests
